claim.detail: The printed box encloses the whole of 2.3 through the end of general rule (3). The markdown wraps every other paragraph of 2.3 in ║ level-2 markers but leaves general rules (2) and (3) unmarked.

verdict.reasoning: Rendered page 703 at 300 dpi: one continuous ruled box runs from the '2.3 THE SEGMENT-LIMIT CLAUSE' heading down to the bottom border just below 'object program.' at the end of General Rule (3); GR (2) and GR (3) are plainly inside it (the left and right rules continue past both, and the bottom rule closes under GR 3). page-703.md wraps the heading, 2.3.1-2.3.4 headings, the Function text, SR (1) and GR (1) in ║ markers, but GR (2) and GR (3) carry none. The words themselves match exactly; what is missing is the level-2 marker on those two rules, so a reader of the markdown would take GR 2-3 as outside the level-2 box. The claim is accurate as described.
